overview: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-Yojana (PM-MKSSY) is a central sector sub-scheme under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) launched in 2023-24 with a total outlay of Rs. 6000 crore, supported by the World Bank and Agence Française de Développement (AFD). It aims to address inherent weaknesses in the fisheries sector through financial and technical interventions to enhance long-term sustainability and resilience by facilitating sectoral reforms. The scheme will be implemented from FY 2023-24 to FY 2026-27 across all states and union territories.
objectives: Address inherent weaknesses in the fisheries sector through financial and technical interventions
Enhance long-term sustainability and resilience of the fisheries sector
Facilitate sectoral reforms for improved fisheries management
Promote private sector participation and entrepreneurship in fisheries
Support development of fisheries value chain including infrastructure and technology adoption
Strengthen socio-economic conditions of fishers and fish farmers
Enhance fish production and productivity through modern aquaculture practices
Improve post-harvest management and reduce losses
eligibility: The scheme is open to all states and union territories for implementation from FY 2023-24 to FY 2026-27. Specific beneficiary eligibility criteria (such as fish farmers, aquaculture units, self-help groups, cooperatives, etc.) are determined at the state/UT level based on notified guidelines under PMMSY framework, focusing on those engaged in fisheries and aquaculture activities requiring financial and technical support for sectoral reforms.
benefits: Financial support for fisheries projects, technical assistance for sectoral reforms, promotion of sustainable aquaculture practices, development of fisheries infrastructure, enhancement of fish production and productivity, support for value addition and post-harvest management, livelihood and nutritional support during fishing bans/lean periods, employment generation in fisheries and allied activities, and facilitation of private investment and entrepreneurship in the sector.
financial_support: The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of subsidies and grants for approved fisheries projects under its framework, with funding pattern following the central sector scheme norms under PMMSY. The total outlay is Rs. 6000 crore, supported by the World Bank and AFD, to be utilized over four years (FY 2023-24 to FY 2026-27) for activities including infrastructure development, technology infusion, value chain enhancement, and sectoral reforms.
application_process: Stakeholders (intended beneficiaries) are required to consult the respective District Fisheries Officer of the district in the state/UT where they intend to undertake fisheries development activities. Proposals are to be submitted through the state/UT fisheries department following the guidelines issued under PMMSY and PM-MKSSY framework.
deadlines: The scheme is implemented from FY 2023-24 to FY 2026-27. Application windows and specific deadlines are determined by state/UT fisheries departments as per annual action plans and notified guidelines.
implementing_agency: Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Government of India
caveats: Implementation is subject to state/UT readiness and fund allocation
Benefits are contingent upon approval of project proposals by state/UT level committees
The scheme period is fixed from FY 2023-24 to FY 2026-27
Financial support follows PMMSY funding patterns and norms
